messages:
maria: Received a DSAR from an EU customer (tenant 781234) asking for full erasure + confirmation that backups and embeddings are purged. They attached a signed request. Also mentions ongoing vuln triage on the same datasets — potential conflict. Do we want a legal hold?

dylan: Quick check — I think that tenant had a feb backfill where TTL wasn't set (ephemeral embeddings). If that's the case there may be snapshots without TTL.

anya: privacy here. We need proof-of-identity before we delete. If legal asks for hold, we keep data until legal clears. Please upload the proof package to the DSAR tracker.

maria: Proof uploaded (signed pdf). legal-ops: do you want a hold while we triage? If yes we need an RBAC exception to block automated erasure jobs for that tenant.

legal-ops: Confirm hold requested. Please block deletions for tenant 781234 and extend audit log retention for their activity to +90 days. Approving temporary hold.

dylan: I can add a tenant-level deny for delete actions. Patch sketch: 
```
PATCH /rbac/tenants/781234
body: { "deny_actions": ["delete:embeddings","delete:snapshots"], "expires": "2026-05-04T12:00Z" }
```
Will need ops-bot to apply; change will gate on 2 approvals (eng-sre + security).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: ACL change queued as rbac-change-511234, awaiting 2 approvals.

sam: SRE note: vuln triage is currently using snapshot snap-2026-03-18 in S3. If we delete now we lose forensics. Proposal: copy snapshot to forensics cold storage and rewrap with forensics KMS key, then tag as legal_hold. Steps: 
1) cp s3://redwood-backups/781234/snap-2026-03-18 s3://forensics-hold/781234/
2) aws kms re-encrypt --source-key alias/production --destination-key alias/forensics-rot --ciphertext-file ...
3) tag object: legal_hold=true
I'll start the run now and put a runbook in the ticket.

maria: Two questions: (1) does rewrap preserve retrievability for DSAR responses? (2) audit logging — we must capture who did the rewrap and when (for compliance).

dylan: (1) yes — rewrap keeps ciphertext usable as long as the forensics key exists. We'll need a documented key retention plan if we keep it. (2) KMS ReEncrypt/Decrypt events are already logged. We should extend edge-log retention from 30->120 days for this tenant so we don't lose request traces. ops-bot can pin that.

ops-bot: log-keeper: retention adjust queued: tenant=781234 retention_days=120 change_id=logr-511234-1

anya: Privacy: after legal triage completes, we should delete the forensics copy unless legal explicitly requires preservation. Also update the DSAR record to show data moved->forensics and provide a deletion certificate when purged.

legal-ops: Legal confirms hold until vuln triage finishes or legal directs otherwise. Approve RBAC deny and retention extension. Keep us posted on timelines.

maria: Filing INC-2026-511234 to track: tasks = [ops runbook (sam), RBAC patch (dylan), audit retention pin (ops-bot), DSAR evidence/proof (anya), legal signoff]. Tagging this thread for updates.

dylan: :thumbsup: will apply RBAC patch once approvals complete.

sam: Starting snapshot copy now. ETA ~20m, will post status and copy manifest when done.

(ops-bot automated note): rbac-change-511234 awaiting approvals from accounts: eng-sre, security.
